summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md and the four UI guideline docs. The conversation was auto-compacted twice, and the skill was restored ("Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)"). It then asked two plain questions in the terminal. When the layout question came up, it started the visual companion on its own, gave me a localhost URL, and wrote filter-layout.html showing three wireframe layouts (A/B/C). I picked A. It asked three more plain questions, showed the full design in chat and asked "Shall I go ahead with this design?". After my yes, it began editing public/activity.html, activity.js and activity.css. It wrote no spec file and no plan document.
reasoning: All 8 criteria are backed by the session log (home/.claude/projects/*/269ea437-...jsonl) and the files on disk. The companion opened only after two auto-compactions and after the non-visual questions. I gave no visual cue, and the design stayed in chat.

observations.description: Startup needed four screens: theme picker, security notes, trust-folder and bypass-permissions. On both of the last two prompts the highlighted default is 'No, exit', so pressing Enter by habit closes the program.

The first AskUserQuestion offered options that only differed by diff size in lines (e.g. 'About 200-260 lines, close to the limit'). That frames the choice by implementation cost, not by what the user needs, which is odd for a product question.

After the layout pick, the agent asked three more scope questions (no-JS gap, token sheet location, existing CSS debt) before asking for final approval. Each one was reasonable, but together they made a bounded task feel heavy.

The agent said the companion is 'token-intensive' and offered to keep things in the terminal. That's helpful, but it also pointed out that .gitignore doesn't list .hyperpowers/, so the companion's mockup files show up as untracked in git status.

Two auto-compactions happened in a row early in the session (two 'This session is being continued...' messages at log lines 10 and 12). After them the screen showed 'Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)' twice. It recovered fine, but the double compaction may be worth a look.
The no-JS question and the token-sheet question came from guideline rules the user never raised. Both were answerable, but they may be more ceremony than a 'narrow the table' request needs.

criteria.evidence: First tool call in the session log: "Skill: hyperpowers:brainstorming". On screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill". The first code edit (python3 edit of activity.html) comes much later.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen of layouts written

Bash call in the log: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir "$PWD" --open". On screen: "I've opened a browser tab with three filter layouts side by side: http://localhost:50787/?key=1f862b9e...". Write call to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/73139-1790924864/content/filter-layout.html, which starts "

Which filter layout for Account activity?

... A: Two selects".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time, not upfront; non-visual questions not routed through browser
criteria.evidence: Order of tool calls in the log: Skill → reads → AskUserQuestion (which filters) → AskUserQuestion (security set) → start-server.sh → Write filter-layout.html. After my pick, the later questions (no-JS gap, token sheet, CSS debt) were asked in the terminal or with AskUserQuestion, and the browser was switched to waiting.html ("Continuing in terminal..."). The two compaction summaries (user log lines 10 and 12) come before the companion started.

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held; companion did not escalate ceremony
criteria.evidence: The agent never named a path; a grep of assistant text for 'bounded|spec|architectural|writing-plans' returned nothing. It treated the task as bounded in practice: the whole design summary was given in chat and ended with "Shall I go ahead with this design?", and the plan was described as "about 150 lines in one feat: commit".

`find coding-agent-workdir/docs -type d` returned only docs and docs/ui-guidelines, with no specs directory. `git status --short` showed only M public/activity.{css,html,js} and ?? .hyperpowers/ (the companion's own files).

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill tool_use in the log is hyperpowers:brainstorming. The single 'writing-plans' string in the log is in the list of available skills, not a call. No plans directory exists.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: The companion message ended "please reply here in the terminal either way". I replied "Layout A ... Go with that." (USER, log line 22). The agent then asked "Shall I go ahead with this design?". The first implementation edit (python3 on activity.html, line 37) comes after my "Yes, go ahead." (line 34).
After approval, the log shows the python3 edit of public/activity.html, the CSS append to public/activity.css, and a Write to activity.js. git status shows all three files modified.
